spellbook.finance/limitations: The ask comes from the sealed product's current catalog market price unless fixedPriceUsd or priceRule undercut was supplied.

With priceRule undercut, decision records the competitor listing seen, the floor, the market price, the chosen ask, and observedAt. anchorSource names what set the ask: competitor_listing, floor, market_fallback, or none.
undercut reads live public TCGplayer listings only when channel is tcgplayer. On manapool, decision.fallbackReason is channel_not_read and the ask is market held at the floor.

undercut excludes the seller's own listings by the paired extension's seller key. With no paired seller, or a cheapest listing with no seller key, fallbackReason is own_seller_unknown and the ask is market.

TCGplayer adds the seller's own shipping to the ask. undercut reads that shipping from the seller's own listing row, records it as decision.ownShippingUsd, and subtracts it, so the ask is the competitor total minus one cent minus ownShippingUsd. The floor applies to that ask.
With no live listing of the seller's own for the product, the rule cannot know the seller's shipping. fallbackReason is own_shipping_unknown and the ask is market.
It counts only factory-sealed units that are owned, not on hold, not reserved for opening, and not opened.
proposed is null when no price exists: no market price and no fixedPriceUsd. The blockers name the reason.
channel_off means the ManaPool account cannot sell sealed product yet. The seller turns that on at ManaPool, and this tool cannot.
manapool_permission_required means no ManaPool connection could be read. Guide the seller through spellbook_manapool_connect_link first.
tcg_product_search_pending means the paired TCGplayer extension is reading this exact product. Call preview again after it finishes.
external_listing_requires_takeover means the selected marketplace already has this product under the seller's account. Ask before passing takeover true.
publisher.state is live or removed only when TCGplayer's exact quantity and ask revisions both match the paired publisher readback. Pending and drift are not confirmed.
It does not say whether the price is a good one. The ask follows the rule the person chose.

description: Preview one sealed listing on ManaPool or TCGplayer without publishing. Returns the proposed quantity and ask, any current offer, TCG publisher readback state, stock and intent revisions, and blockers. For TCGplayer, the first call may queue an exact seller-grid SKU read; call again after the paired extension finishes. After submitting, call preview again: publisher.state live confirms an offer, and removed confirms a zero-quantity removal. Pass this preview's channel, ask, and revisions to spellbook_sealed_listing_submit.

boxId.description: The TCGplayer product id of the sealed product, the boxId on a spellbook_sealed_portfolio row. Required.

cap.description: The most units to offer at once. Omit to offer every eligible unit.

channel.description: Marketplace to preview. Defaults to manapool.

fixedPriceUsd.description: A fixed ask in USD for every unit. Omit to list at the product's current market price. Cannot be combined with priceRule.

floorMarketFraction.description: undercut only. The floor as a fraction of catalog market, used when floorUsd is omitted. Defaults to 0.9.

floorUsd.description: undercut only. The lowest ask in USD the rule may choose. Omit to use catalog market times floorMarketFraction.

game.description: The game of the product. Defaults to mtg.

kind.description: The sealed kind, the kind on the same spellbook_sealed_portfolio row. Required, because units are counted by kind and boxId together.

language.description: The product language code, such as EN or JA. Defaults to EN.

priceRule.description: market asks the catalog market price. undercut sets the ask so the item plus the seller's own shipping lands one cent under the cheapest TCGplayer item plus shipping from another seller, never below the floor. Omit for market.

takeover.description: True adopts a listing on the selected marketplace that SpellBook did not create. Defaults to false; pass true only after the person agrees.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that holds the sealed units, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_listing_preview
